name: Aerial Life
source:
The protagonist is a part-time beta tester at a game developer company which runs the popular VR game Aerial Life. However, there was an unknown bug after the latest major update and he became trapped in the VR world, along with fellow beta-tester Otome, who lost her memories of the outer world. Unable to log out, they had to stay in the virtual world for a while and complete the grand quest. Will he be able to recover her memories and break free from the game?

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2018/09/25/september-2018-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri~![/url]]
translation:
主角是一家游戏开发公司的兼职测试员，该公司运营流行的VR游戏《空中生活》。然而，在最新的重大更新后出现了一个未知的错误，他和另一位测试者乙女一起被困在了VR世界中，乙女失去了对外部世界的记忆。由于无法退出，他们只能在虚拟世界中停留一段时间，完成伟大的任务。他能否恢复她的记忆并摆脱游戏呢？

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2018/09/25/september-2018-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri~![/url]]
